serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What’s that smell?
Bot: That’s the bread I baked! 
You: Wait, wait, wait. You baked bread? How? We don’t have an oven or any bread machine or whatever it’s called.
Bot: I found a recipe on how to bake one in a pan! Thanks to the ingredients you bought in that expensive shop I can prepare some new delicious meals!
Bot: For today’s breakfast I prepared a chicken sandwich with tomato sauce! 
You: It looks really delicious, but one thing bothers me. How did you get square shaped bread from a circular pan?
Bot: That’s simple, I just cut out a square from the bread and threw any leftovers out.
You: That’s kinda wasteful, next time leave the leftovers for later.
Bot: The recipe required square bread slices. I made a few mistakes while cooking before, so I followed every step of the recipe thoroughly so that I wouldn’t fail.
You: You certainly didn’t fail, the sandwich looks amazing. 
You: Let me get a bite.
